findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/bundle.js::toctou gap between the trust probe and the occupant's first git operation
findings.title: TOCTOU gap between the trust probe and the occupant's first git operation
findings.action: Documented as an accepted, pre-existing property shared with the config-driven path; out of scope per spec FAFF-1016 section 2 (deeper fetch sandboxing excluded).
findings.disposition_rationale: The identical check-then-act window already exists on the pre-existing config-driven resolveBundleStore(root) path (it also reads config/decides the occupant, then calls gitRemoteBundleStore(root), which re-resolves .git discovery at that later moment) -- this diff does not introduce a new gap, only a new, narrower code path that shares the same filesystem-level property. The spec's own section 2 explicitly excludes 'sandboxing the git-remote fetch itself' as a separate, later hardening. The threat requires local write access to the exact root the operator pointed at, which is the scenario the gate's containment+origin check already targets.

occurrences.title: TOCTOU gap between the trust probe and the occupant's first git operation

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/bundle.js::refusal gave no diagnostic hint when the underlying probe failed for a benign reason
findings.title: Refusal gave no diagnostic hint when the underlying probe failed for a benign reason
findings.action: Fixed: isGitRemoteRootTrusted/gitWorktreeTop/gitOriginUrl now accept an optional diag array that collects {probe,dir,stderr} on a probe failure; the verify action's refusal message appends a trailing (git: ...) hint when diag is non-empty, while the pinned refusal substring stays byte-identical.
findings.disposition_rationale: Cheap, additive, non-breaking fix (optional 3rd parameter; every 2-arg caller and every existing boolean-return selftest assertion is unchanged). Verified by two new selftest assertions distinguishing a probe-failure hint from a clean containment/origin mismatch (no hint) -- both at the direct-function and CLI level.

occurrences.title: Refusal gave no diagnostic hint when the underlying probe failed for a benign reason

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/bundle.js::git-remote origin equality is an exact-string compare, refusing equivalent url forms
findings.title: git-remote origin equality is an exact-string compare, refusing equivalent URL forms
findings.action: Accepted as a deliberate over-strictness in the same family the spec itself ratified (the linked-worktree refusal, FAFF-1016 section 2) -- not fixed in this PR.
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec's own words: the origin check 'cannot independently reject a containment-passing root' -- path-containment (top-level equality) is the load-bearing check; origin equality is the explicit, machine-checkable statement of the fetch-target invariant, not an independent gate. A URL-form variant (trailing slash, ssh-vs-https) of the SAME remote is refused only when top-level containment ALREADY passed, i.e. only as additional (not weaker) strictness. Normalising URL forms is a reasonable future enhancement but not required by this ticket's three ratified decisions.

occurrences.title: git-remote origin equality is an exact-string compare, refusing equivalent URL forms
